episodes.synopsis: Eve is an underground golfer who supports poor street orphans with the money she makes from illegal golfing matches. But her life is about to change forever when she meets a young golfer who's just arrived from Japan...
episodes.title: Rainbow Bullet

episodes.synopsis: Eve battles the "Innocent Tyrant" Aoi on one of the course's toughest holes: a monstrous L-shaped par 5 with a thick forest surrounding the course. Can the "Rainbow Bullet" win out against this strange challenger from a faraway land?
episodes.title: Innocent Tyrant

episodes.synopsis: Eve wants to play Aoi badly, and she's willing to do whatever it takes. She pulls some strings to get invited to the last day of the world junior championship, and begins her game...
episodes.title: A Match Between Just the Two of Us

episodes.synopsis: After pulling strings to get into the championship, Eve owes the mob a favor. She'll have to duel it out on a huge, randomly generated golf course. Can she win and make it back to challenge Aoi before she leaves?
episodes.title: Vipère

episodes.synopsis: After she fails to catch up with Aoi, Eve thinks she's lost her chance to play together forever. But then she hears about VR golf...
episodes.title: VR

episodes.synopsis: When the mafia tries to bulldoze Eve's home to build a new casino, she's forced into a deadly game of golf to earn the money for a new home.
episodes.title: Rebellion's Cry

episodes.synopsis: Eve faces her former boss, Rose, in a climactic battle inside a huge underground hall where golf courses are randomly generated by thousands of tons of machinery.
episodes.title: Purple Bullet

episodes.synopsis: Eve's battle with Rose reaches its conclusion. The winner wins enough prize money to be set for life, and the loser will be killed by the mob!
episodes.title: Final Bullet

episodes.synopsis: Now in Japan, Eve is forced to make her way alone, far from the world she's known. But before she can even settle in, she's already found herself challenged to a tough match of golf!
episodes.title: Ichina Saotome Wants to Be a Pro Caddy!

episodes.synopsis: As she settles into her new life in Japan, Eve finds herself faced with unfamiliar surroundings and new people. As she sets out for a night on the town, she finds herself caught up in a tense game of... mini-golf?
episodes.title: Evangeline Is Frightfully Upset

episodes.synopsis: After finally making it to Japan, Eve is all ready to play Aoi at last. But before she can, Aoi is spirited away to play a match in another prefecture. And then Eve gets caught up in an unexpected match of her own...
episodes.title: No Matter How Tall a Weed Grows, It Will Never Reach the Sun

episodes.synopsis: It's the day of the prefectural qualifiers, and Eve and Aoi are a shoo-in to win. That is, if they can keep their arguments from ruining the match!
episodes.title: Are Aoi and Eve Okay Together? The Doubles Championship Begins

episodes.synopsis: The Doubles Championship heats up as Eve and Aoi face off against the best high-school players in Japan. Can they take their first step towards worldwide fame and glory?
episodes.title: I Think Who Gets What Room Is Very Important for Girls
